newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - China talk dominates market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - China talk dominates market.

text.p: Rumors that China either bought or canceled U.S. soymeal purchases dominated talk in cash markets Monday, but basis levels remained flat to slightly lower, brokers said.
Talk that China cancelled up to 150,000 tonnes of soymeal swirled through the market as did talk that China bought 100,00 tonnes of soymeal, traders said.
"It makes sense that they (China) would be looking around at these prices," one Midwest dealer said. "They can't get anything out of South America, so the U.S. would be a logical source for tonnage."

Weakness in spot offers was prompted by continued good harvest weather throughout the Midwest. The nearly ideal weather enabled farmers to make good progress cutting their crops so more soybeans were making it to processors, meal brokers said.
